name: site-footer
title: Site footer
description: Public footer with columns, centered and simple layouts. Optional brand, description, newsletter slot, legal and social links, and an icon-only theme switcher at every width. Uses a div by default inside a layout footer; opt into landmark for standalone pages. Empty groups stay absent; navigation names use the English/Spanish catalog or navLabel. Social labels must name the network. Simple mode preserves inherited typography and the public templates’ spacing.
author: gntik-ai
